text: Android: multi-account data layer, accounts table, per-account sessions, server protocol floor (B1)

Merged: b16431f + 861e62d cherry-picked, plus 5c4d293 removing the now-unused AppDb.clearAll (HEAD 5c4d293). Full gate green. Review: migration is transactional and deletes the legacy keys only after the database has opened; the registry awaits cursor writes and defers only flag/preference writes; 401/426 are scoped per session; the protocol floor asks /app-version once per server. Behaviour changes accepted: outdated flags cleared per process start, a background 401 marks the row signed out at once, the typed server URL persists only on a successful login, account deletion removes lists+token+row. Follow-ups noted on T-292.
